_comment: The async evaluator is isolated because promise continuations require full-suite coverage analysis and must not borrow the synchronous core score. The 24 August 2026 v1 baseline instrumented 448 mutants, with 4 documented equivalent/performance-only exclusions and 444 scored mutants: 381 killed, 6 timed out, 49 survived, 8 uncovered. That is 87.16% overall / 88.76% covered and 85.81% with every timeout counted as a failure. The 85% floor is therefore timeout-independent and should be ratcheted upward, never lowered.
